semiconductor_relevance: High — IBARAKI GRINDING WHEEL specializes in precision grinding tools essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: IBARAKI GRINDING WHEEL Co., Ltd. manufactures precision grinding tools tailored for difficult-to-machine materials, including ultrathin cut-off wheels and electroplated tools. Their products enhance machining quality and efficiency, making them vital for semiconductor fabrication and related industries.
capabilities: Ultrathin cut-off wheels for silicon and ceramics
Diamond and CBN electroplated tools for complex shapes
Custom grinding solutions for semiconductor materials
Patented wire-mesh grinding wheels for efficient chip evacuation

regional_presence.Japan: Manufacturing operations are based in Joso City, Japan, where key processes are managed under an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality management system.
